name: ScrollArea
summary: A scroll region whose scrollbar is drawn over the content, never beside it: the content has the same width and alignment whether it overflows or not. Native scrolling stays (wheel, touch, keys, find in page, anchors); only the bar is replaced, by a thin thumb at the region's end edge that can be dragged, with the track paging on a click. Use it for every scroll region. Not for the document itself on small screens, which keeps the browser's own bar.
a11y: The drawn bar is hidden from assistive technology. The viewport enters the Tab order only while its selected axis overflows, and keeps an inset token focus ring. Give label or labelledBy for its accessible name. An explicit tabIndex overrides automatic focusability; content that fits adds no default Tab stop.
Forced colours and touch screens get the system's own scrollbar back.

keys.keys: Arrow keys, Page Up, Page Down, Home, End, Space

props.name: mode
props.description: `auto` shows the scrollbar while scrolling, on hover and while it's dragged, then fades it; `always` shows it whenever the content overflows.

props.name: maxSize
props.description: The most the region grows before it scrolls; `fill` takes the height its parent gives it.

props.name: inset
props.description: Padding on the content inside the scroll box, never on the box, so the region still scrolls edge to edge.

props.name: surface
props.description: `sunken` shows the region's bounds with a sunken fill, for a region that doesn't fill a surface of its own (a list inside a page); `none` when its surface already shows them.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the region. Give label or labelledBy to every region that can overflow.

props.name: labelledBy
props.description: Id of the visible heading that names this region; preferred over repeating the heading as a label.

props.name: id
props.description: Id of the scrolling element, for a skip link or an anchor.

props.name: tabIndex
props.description: Explicit focus order; `-1` for a skip link's target. By default, 0 only while the selected axis overflows.

props.name: viewportRef
props.description: The scrolling element, for scrolling it from code.

props.name: contain
props.description: Stops the scroll at the region's end instead of passing it on to the page. Only inside a popup or a modal; an in-page region always passes the wheel on, so the page never stops scrolling under the pointer.
